newsitem.title: USA: Ag-Chem sees FY97 EPS above $1.30.
newsitem.headline: Ag-Chem sees FY97 EPS above $1.30.

text.p: Ag-Chem Equipment Co Inc chief executive officer Alvin McQuinn said Monday he expected earnings for fiscal year 1997 ending in September will be above $1.30 a share.
"I'd be disappointed if we didn't earn $1.30-plus-cents, $1.35 maybe," a share in 1997, he said following the company's annual meeting here.
The company reported earnings of $1.01 a share in fiscal year 1996 and $1.19 in 1995.
McQuinn also said he expects fiscal 1997 revenues to be in the $335 million-$350 million range, compared to $280.2 million a year ago.

"I don't know whether investors should be expecting fiscal year 1997 of between $335 million and $350 million, but it's what I expect... if the market stays as strong as it is now, we will be in that area with no problem," he said.
McQuinn said operating margins should recover from their first quarter of 4.4 percent to reach last year's 6.6 percent.

"I think operating margins will pick up because the first quarter's 4.4 percent reflects inventory clean up that's virtually complete now," he said. "So I expect our margins to strengthen throughout the year... I think it will bounce back up to last year's 6.6 percent."
McQuinn said the fertilizer and farm chemical equipment manufacturer had actually sold out of one line through the end of April.
"Inventories are in beautiful decline right now," he said. "We will be somewhat short of inventory in the next 90 days."
